assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness to guide further management.
The service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis code I47.1.
The service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis code R42.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
